properties.digitized_from: Real block boundary built from DataSF's official street centerlines; the plan's own A/B internal split has no mapped street, so it's a straight bisection along the block's long axis, not a real line.
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-19 for the block-by-block plan walk-through (docs/briefs/mission_bay_block_inventory.csv): the owner asked directly why 'confirmed vacant' blocks weren't being traced and registered as planned, per this project's own Mission Rock precedent (docs/briefs/mission-rock-geometry.md) -- an unbuilt block gets the same transform-and-register discipline as a built one, not left as a bare note. an operating surface parking lot, satellite-confirmed, between Mission Bay School and the UCSF Preliminary Utilities Plant, north of Nelson Rising Lane. The plan's own Dec 2019 Land Use Map colors this whole row light blue, the same category used for UCSF's other institutional buildings on this campus, but no specific named development or announced project was found for this parcel -- status left as 'planned' per the plan's own land-use designation, not a guessed project name. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: (1) The 'operating surface parking lot, satellite-confirmed' wording above is our own imagery observation (parked cars fill this block in USDA NAIP imagery, viewed 2026-09-29), not something the cited Land Use Map shows; it is cited to that imagery, not the map. (2) The Dec 2019 OCII Land Use Map colors this row 'UCSF' with no use type, so 'institutional' went beyond it; UCSF's June 12, 2025 CAC deck (page 3, citing UCSF's Long Range Development Plan) lists 'Block 15 - Housing' among 'Undeveloped parcels remaining', so `use` is corrected from institutional to residential and status stays planned. (3) 'Mission Bay South' in project_name is the plan-area label; the map does not print those words (it prefixes north-of-creek blocks with N, e.g. N1-N7, and this block is numbered without a prefix). 2026-10-02: public-text pass. digitized_from, notes reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- digitized_from: 'Real block boundary from real street geometry (src/block_fit.py load_blocks(), polygonized from data/raw/official_street_centerlines.geojson); the plan's own A/B internal split has no mapped street, so it's a straight bisection along the block's long axis, not a real line.'; notes: 'No building on this site as of UCSF's June 2025 CAC deck ('Undeveloped parcels remaining'); parked cars fill the block in USDA NAIP imagery (viewed 2026-09-29), an imagery observation that no cited document states. The OCII plan's Dec 2019 Land Use Map colors this block 'UCSF' (no use type); UCSF's own June 2025 deck, citing its Long Range Development Plan, lists Block 15 as Housing. No specific project, developer, or timeline was found in this pass.'.
properties.accuracy_caveat: PARTIALLY REAL -- the outer boundary is a real polygonized city block from real street geometry, not hand-traced; only the internal A/B split line is approximate (a bisection, since no real street divides this block into A and B).
